cues.en: In order to finalize our understanding of functions, we have to talk about scope.
cues.zh: 要完整理解函式，還必須談作用域。

cues.en: Another one of our key terms.
What is scope?
Let's have a look.
Scope is something present in a lot of programming languages.
cues.zh: 許多程式語言，都有作用域。

cues.en: And scope simply means What variables do I have?
cues.zh: 簡單說，就是我有哪些變數

cues.en: Access to.
That's it.
So what do I mean by that?
Well, we've seen this before, right where I do print and then let's say name if I click run.
cues.zh: 以前看過，寫 print，再給 name，執行，

cues.en: I'll get an error.
A name error.
Name name is not defined because.
cues.zh: 名稱 name 未定義，因為

cues.en: Well, it doesn't exist.
Right.
And up to this point, we haven't really discussed this, but this is because of scope.
cues.zh: 目前還沒正式談過，但這和作用域有關。

cues.en: What variables do I have access to?
The Python interpreter says, Hey, what do I have access to?
cues.zh: Python 直譯器會問：「我可以取得什麼？」

cues.en: And when we use something that it doesn't understand or it doesn't have access to, it's going to throw a name error.
cues.zh: 使用不認得、或無法存取的名稱，就會拋出 NameError，

cues.en: Or variable is not defined here and scope in python has what we call functional scope or function scope.
cues.zh: 說變數未定義。Python 這裡談所謂函式作用域。

cues.en: What does that mean?
Well, up until now, when we create a variable like total equals to 100, this is part of what we call
cues.zh: 到目前為止，建立 total = 100 這類變數，它屬於

cues.en: global scope.
That means anybody on this file has access to this total variable.
cues.zh: 表示這個檔案裡，可以存取 total。

cues.en: I can use this inside of a conditional block.
I can use it inside of a function.
It has global scope.
But when I say Python has a function scope.
cues.zh: 但說 Python 有函式作用域，

cues.en: What I mean is that when we create a function and let's say we create total as some or let's say some
cues.zh: 意思是，建立函式，例如 some_

cues.en: func.
And we create total inside of the function.
If I print total here and I click run.
I get the same thing.
Name total is not defined.
This is because of Python's function scope.
cues.zh: 因為 Python 的函式作用域。

cues.en: Any time we create a variable if it's not inside of a function.
cues.zh: 這個入門示例裡，不在函式內建立的變數，

cues.en: Then it is part of the global scope.
We have access to it.
But you see over here we get that red underlined, undefined name total.
cues.zh: 但這裡有紅色底線，提示 undefined name 'total'。

cues.en: If, let's say, for example, I had a condition, if true.
cues.zh: 例如有個條件 if True，

cues.en: Then X equals to ten.
If I do this and I say X and I click Run.
I have ten because.
Well, although I have indentation.
The only time I create a new scope.
cues.zh: 在這裡的示例，只有定義函式才建立新作用域，

cues.en: You can think of this as a new universe that we spawn.
cues.zh: 可以想成產生新的宇宙，

cues.en: Well, we can only do that when we define a function like this.
cues.zh: 就是定義這樣的函式時。

cues.en: So think of scope as a new world that we create.
In our case, when we create a function, we create a new world that anything that's indented inside of the function is its own world that we don't really have access to.
cues.zh: 建立函式，裡面縮排的內容就是自己的世界，外面不能直接存取。

cues.en: We can only use total if we indent print.
cues.zh: 只有把 print 縮排到裡面，才能用 total，

cues.en: And it's part of this world.
That's what scope is.
